stimuli.title: 기차역
stimuli.visualDescription: 여행객 한 명이 전광판을 확인하며 여행 가방 손잡이를 잡고 있다.

stimuli.title: 식당

stimuli.title: 사무실
stimuli.visualDescription: 한 여성이 책상에서 헤드셋을 끼고 전화 통화를 하고 있다.

stimuli.title: 공원
stimuli.visualDescription: 관리인이 산책로 옆 화단에 물을 주고 있다.

stimuli.title: Question 1
stimuli.audioScript: Where should I leave these packages? A. On the counter by the door. B. They arrived yesterday. C. No, I did not order lunch.

stimuli.title: Question 2
stimuli.audioScript: When will the budget meeting begin? A. In the main conference room. B. At ten thirty. C. The budget was approved.

stimuli.title: Question 3
stimuli.audioScript: Who is leading the orientation today? A. It lasts about an hour. B. In the training room. C. Ms. Patel from Human Resources.

stimuli.title: Question 4
stimuli.audioScript: Why was the shipment delayed? A. There was a problem at the port. B. By express delivery. C. About twenty boxes.

stimuli.title: Question 5
stimuli.audioScript: How often is the safety equipment inspected? A. The inspector is downstairs. B. Once every three months. C. It is very reliable.

stimuli.title: Question 6
stimuli.audioScript: Could you send me the revised schedule? A. The train was on time. B. I revised the price. C. Sure, I will e-mail it now.

stimuli.title: Question 7
stimuli.audioScript: Haven’t we met at a trade show before? A. Yes, in Singapore last year. B. The show starts at noon. C. I will introduce the speaker.

stimuli.title: Question 8
stimuli.audioScript: Which printer should I use? A. I printed fifty copies. B. The one next to the supply cabinet. C. The paper is recyclable.

stimuli.title: Question 9
stimuli.audioScript: Would you like tea or coffee? A. Yes, I liked the café. B. The cups are in the cabinet. C. Coffee, please.

stimuli.title: Question 10
stimuli.audioScript: The lobby renovation looks nearly finished. A. Yes, only the lighting remains. B. I finished the report yesterday. C. The lobby is on the first floor.

stimuli.title: Question 11
stimuli.audioScript: Do you know whether the client confirmed the order? A. The order form is blue. B. I’ll check the latest message. C. We met the client downstairs.

stimuli.title: Question 12
stimuli.audioScript: Why don’t we move the display closer to the entrance? A. The entrance fee is ten dollars. B. I moved here last month. C. That should attract more visitors.

stimuli.title: Question 13
stimuli.audioScript: How many applicants did you interview? A. Six in total. B. For the accounting position. C. At the downtown office.

stimuli.title: Question 14
stimuli.audioScript: Is the cafeteria still serving lunch? A. The soup was delicious. B. No, it closed at two. C. I served on the committee.

stimuli.title: Question 15
stimuli.audioScript: Where did you put the signed contract? A. The director signed it. B. We renewed it for a year. C. It’s in the top drawer.

stimuli.title: Question 16
stimuli.audioScript: Should I reserve a small room or the auditorium? A. The auditorium would be safer. B. The reservation is under Lee. C. The speech was interesting.

stimuli.title: Question 17
stimuli.audioScript: Can the maintenance team fix this today? A. The fee is included. B. They are already on their way. C. I fixed the date on the form.

stimuli.title: Question 18
stimuli.audioScript: What did the survey participants receive? A. Nearly two hundred people. B. They completed it online. C. A discount coupon.

stimuli.title: Question 19
stimuli.audioScript: Didn’t Maria submit the proposal? A. She asked for one more day. B. The proposal has three sections. C. Yes, Maria designed the logo.

stimuli.title: Question 20
stimuli.audioScript: How do I connect to the guest network? A. The guests arrived early. B. Use the password on your badge. C. The network meeting was canceled.

stimuli.title: Question 21
stimuli.audioScript: When are the replacement parts expected? A. The machine needs three parts. B. I replaced the batteries. C. Sometime on Thursday afternoon.

stimuli.title: Question 22
stimuli.audioScript: Who approved the new travel policy? A. I believe the finance director did. B. Travel takes about two hours. C. The policy starts next month.

stimuli.title: Question 23
stimuli.audioScript: Would you mind lowering the volume? A. The volume is on the shelf. B. Not at all—I’ll turn it down. C. I lowered the price yesterday.

stimuli.title: Question 24
stimuli.audioScript: Why is the west entrance locked? A. Use the westbound platform. B. I left my key at home. C. It is being painted this morning.

stimuli.title: Question 25
stimuli.audioScript: Has the invoice been corrected yet? A. Yes, the updated one is attached. B. The invoice total is high. C. I attached the poster to the wall.

stimuli.title: 호텔 예약
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: Good morning. I booked a room for two nights, but my confirmation shows only one.
Man: I can correct that. May I see your confirmation number?
Woman: Certainly. It is H-4821. I also requested a room away from the elevator.

stimuli.title: 제품 시연
stimuli.audioScript:
Man: The client moved tomorrow’s product demonstration to three o’clock.
Woman: Then we have time to test the new projector in the morning.
Man: Good idea. I’ll also bring printed copies of the pricing sheet.

stimuli.title: 배송 문의
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: My tracking page says the office chairs were delivered, but they are not here.
Man: Let me contact the driver. The shipment may have been left at the loading entrance.
Woman: Please ask the facilities team to check there as well.

stimuli.title: 교육 일정
stimuli.audioScript:
Man: Are you attending the spreadsheet workshop on Friday?
Woman: I planned to, but my supervisor scheduled a client call at the same time.
Man: The trainer is offering the workshop again next Tuesday.

stimuli.title: 식당 행사
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: We need a vegetarian option for the company dinner.
Man: The chef can prepare mushroom pasta if we confirm the number by Wednesday.
Woman: I’ll survey the staff this afternoon.

stimuli.title: 인쇄 오류
stimuli.audioScript:
Man: These brochures have the old telephone number on the back.
Woman: I sent the printer a corrected file yesterday.
Man: I’ll call them before they produce the remaining copies.

stimuli.title: 공항 이동
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: Our flight leaves at eight, so the airport shuttle at six should work.
Man: The hotel clerk said road construction may add thirty minutes.
Woman: Then let’s take the five-thirty shuttle instead.

stimuli.title: 채용 면접
stimuli.audioScript:
Man: The first candidate has strong technical experience.
Woman: Yes, but we should ask more about project leadership in the second interview.
Man: I’ll add that topic to our interview notes.

stimuli.title: 전시 부스
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: Our booth is next to the main entrance this year.
Man: That should bring more visitors, but we need another staff member during lunch.
Woman: I’ll ask Daniel whether he can cover that hour.

stimuli.title: 소프트웨어 갱신
stimuli.audioScript:
Man: The accounting software license expires at the end of the month.
Woman: The annual plan is cheaper than paying monthly.
Man: I’ll send the annual-plan quote to the department head.

stimuli.title: 회의실 변경
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: The large conference room is unavailable because the air conditioner is being repaired.
Man: Could we use the training room on the second floor?
Woman: Yes, I’ll update the calendar invitation.

stimuli.title: 재고 확인
stimuli.audioScript:
Man: We have only twelve blue folders left.
Woman: The supplier offers free shipping for orders over fifty units.
Man: Let’s order sixty, since the new employees arrive next week.

stimuli.title: 고객 행사
stimuli.audioScript:
Woman: Registration for Saturday’s customer event is higher than expected.
Man: We should move the welcome desk into the lobby to reduce the line.
Woman: I’ll ask security to open the side doors too.

stimuli.audioScript: All new employees must complete the online security course by September 18. The course takes about forty minutes and can be accessed from the staff portal. Send completion questions to Ms. Rivera in Information Technology.

stimuli.title: 박물관 투어

stimuli.audioScript: Breakfast is served in the Garden Room from six thirty to ten. Guests leaving before six thirty may request a boxed meal at the front desk by nine the previous evening.

stimuli.title: 식당 공지

stimuli.title: 박람회 초대
stimuli.body: Register by March 20 for free admission to the Green Building Expo. Workshops require separate reservations because seating is limited. A complete schedule is available on the event Web site.

stimuli.title: 서비스 보고

stimuli.title: 회원 갱신
stimuli.body: Your museum membership expires on December 31. Renew online by December 15 to receive two complimentary guest passes. New cards will be mailed within five business days.

The gray filing cabinets are temporarily out of stock. Black cabinets can ship immediately, or gray units will be available next month.

Please send six black cabinets now. Our records room opens in two weeks, so we cannot wait until next month.
